input.standard: ASTM E741 (tracer gas concentration decay, single zone); ASTM D6245 (occupant CO2 as tracer)
input.purpose: Measure the served volume V_lab of /habitat/lab (m3) as V = Qe * tau, with the three Lab occupants as CO2 source and scrubber-1-v6 as the pump.

quantities.name: co2 of the lab (co2-1-v6), logged every minute
V_lab, served volume of the lab

steps.why: Raise: reduced effective flow (0.3 m3/min) so the 3 occupants (about 1.14 L/min CO2) push the Lab CO2 up several hundred ppm from 1800 ppm, staying under 2800 ppm.
Decay: full speed (Qe = 1 m3/min); record the decay towards its equilibrium for about one time constant (tau about 30 min if V about 30 m3) and fit C_eq + (C0 - C_eq) exp(-t/tau).

abort.when: the device refuses a step's command
a monitored person leaves the 45-120 bpm band, the monitoring is lost, or one more person enters the Lab

monitoring.reason: The three Lab occupants breathe the air whose CO2 is raised by the test.

expected.start: Lab CO2 about 1800 ppm at start (measured by co2-1-v6); occupants held at 3, awake, no one entering or leaving.
expected.rise: During step 1 CO2 rises by several hundred ppm (about +250 to +350 ppm if V is about 30 m3: net rate (G - Qe*C)/V with G = 3 x 0.38 L/min = 1.14 L/min), peaking below 2800 ppm.
expected.decay: In step 2 CO2 falls monotonically towards an equilibrium near G/Qe (about 1100 to 1200 ppm); fitted tau = V/Qe gives V_lab = 1 m3/min x tau, expected of the order of 30 m3 (first guess, default of the shelf, range 10 to 200).
expected.hatch: Hab-B CO2 (1 occupant) stays nearly flat and does not follow the Lab curve if the closed hatch exchanges little air.
expected.refuted_if: The curve is not exponential, the fitted equilibrium is far from G/Qe, the Hab-B CO2 moves with the Lab's, the rise is under the sensor noise (V much above 100 m3), or tau fitted in step 1 and step 2 disagree: then the one-zone or constant-source hypothesis fails and V_lab is not accepted.

hypotheses: The Lab is one well-mixed zone.

The exchange through the closed hatch to Hab-B is not measured and is not assumed to be zero; the hatch stays closed during the whole test and Hab-B CO2 is recorded to show any exchange (design inter-module ventilation with hatch closed is 3 m3/min, signed).
The CO2 source is 3 occupants awake at 0.38 L/min each (0.26 to 0.45 band), held constant; a change of occupancy invalidates the curve.
The scrubber effective flow is 1 m3/min at full speed and scales with speed; its 3.33 min lag is small against tau and is excluded from the fit window at the start of each step.
First guess of V is 30 m3 (shelf default), used only to size step durations.

justifications.reason: Under the 3200 ppm ceiling and 1000 ppm above the 1800 start, 400 ppm below abort.
At the signed ceiling, below elevated 3500 ppm of the station.

Above the 35 percent minimum, on the safe side.

justifications.reference: rise about 14-20 ppm/min from (G - Qe*C)/V with G=1.14 L/min, Qe=0.3 m3/min, C=1800 ppm, V=30 m3; 20 min gives several hundred ppm, about one lag plus margin
justifications.reason: Enough rise above noise while peak stays under 2800 ppm.

justifications.reference: tau = V/Qe = 30 m3 / 1 m3/min = 30 min (first guess V = 30)
justifications.reason: One time constant for the decay fit; total 50 min within 60.
